targetReport.title: 旅游饭店星级的划分与评定 (Classification and Accreditation for Star-rated Tourist Hotels), GB/T 14308-2010
title_aliases: 旅游饭店星级的划分与评定
targetReport.publisher: 中国国家标准化管理委员会 (Standardization Administration of China)
targetReport.description: The recommended national standard that defines China's one-to-five-star hotel grades and the accreditation procedure behind them, GB/T 14308-2010, issued 2010-10-18 and effective 2011-01-01, replacing GB/T 14308-2003 in full; drafted by 国家旅游局监督管理司 under technical committee TC210 (全国旅游标准化技术委员会), 主管部门 文化和旅游部; reviewed 2016-12-31 with the conclusion 修订, and superseded in full by GB/T 14308-2023 from 2024-03-01. Statistical yearbooks use it to define the 星级饭店 series: a star-rated hotel is one whose 设备、设施、服务符合《旅游饭店星级的划分与评定》（GB/T14308-2010）标准 and has been accredited by the tourism authority. This node is the 2010 EDITION, on the GB/T 4754-2017 shape — each edition carries its own standard number and its own platform page — so a citation naming the number or year reaches it and a bare title does not (Suzhou's zb16, refused this round, could as well mean the 2023 edition in force for its data year). The cited page is the standard's own entry on SAMR's 全国标准信息公共服务平台 (std.samr.gov.cn), the national standards register, recording number, status, dates, the replaced and replacing editions, committee, drafters and 主管部门; HANDOFF 084's URL for this instrument was the platform's page for the 2020 revision PROJECT (20201806-T-357), not the standard. Minted round 43.
targetReport.cadence_note: A standing national standard, revised roughly once a decade: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2010, 2023. This node is the 2010 edition.

targetReport.title: 国家危险废物名录 (2016) (National Catalogue of Hazardous Wastes, 2016 edition)
targetReport.publisher: 生态环境部 (Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China; issued as 环境保护部 jointly with 国家发展和改革委员会 and 公安部)
targetReport.description: The 2016 edition of China's statutory list of hazardous wastes, made under the 固体废物污染环境防治法 and promulgated as 环境保护部、国家发展和改革委员会、公安部令第39号 on 2016-06-14, in force from 2016-08-01, repealing the 2008 edition (环境保护部、国家发展和改革委员会令第1号): 46 categories and 479 wastes coded by GB/T 4754-2011 industry of origin, with a new 危险废物豁免管理清单 annex. It is the reference that decides what counts as 危险废物 in environmental statistics, and the national statistical yearbook's 指标解释 for 危险废物产生量 says so with the edition year — 按《国家危险废物名录》（2016）填报. Later editions are separate instruments retitled with their year (国家危险废物名录（2021年版）, 生态环境部等五部门令第15号, from 2021-01-01; 国家危险废物名录（2025年版）, 令第36号, from 2025-01-01), so this node is the 2016 edition only and a bare 《国家危险废物名录》 (Jiangsu nj0914, refused this round) does not reach it. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own 2016 page (mee.gov.cn/gkml/hbb/bl/201606/t20160621_354852.htm) now redirects to MEE's 404 page and its 规章库 lists only the 2025 edition, so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第39号 (国务院公报 2016年第26号 on gov.cn, the text and signatures in full, attachments omitted) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations; move the URL if MEE restores a page for this edition. MEE's interpretation of the edition is at https://www.mee.gov.cn/gkml/sthjbgw/qt/201606/t20160621_354849.htm. Minted round 43.
targetReport.cadence_note: A standing ministerial list, reissued as a new 令 roughly every five years (2008, 2016, 2021, 2025). This node is the 2016 edition.

targetReport.title: 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度 (Human Resources and Social Security Statistical Survey System)
title_aliases: 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度
targetReport.publisher: 人力资源和社会保障部 (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of the People's Republic of China)
targetReport.description: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度), formulated by the Ministry under the Statistics Law and approved by NBS: eleven full-coverage reporting surveys — petitions, employment, the human-resources market, vocational skills, talent in publicly-owned enterprises, personnel of public institutions, labour relations, wages and welfare of government bodies and institutions, social insurance, mediation and arbitration, and labour inspection — filled in by local HRSS departments, with monthly headline figures released through the Ministry's 数字人社 pages, the annual 人力资源和社会保障事业发展统计公报 by end-June, and 中国劳动统计年鉴. The national statistical yearbook's employment chapter names it as the source of its registered-unemployment series: 城镇登记失业人员数据，是人力资源社会保障部根据其《人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度》整理提供. The cited page is the instrument's own entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing (/fw/bmdcxmsp/bmzd/), the approving authority's register, carrying purpose, content, scope, method, organisation and release arrangements in full; the 2025-06-04 entry is the newer of the two on the listing (the other is 2023-02-15). NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the Ministry and the cited page is on the approving body's host (rule 19: authorship, not host) — move the URL if a mohrss.gov.cn page for the instrument is located. Found round 43 by matching the listing's 512 titles against re-fetched yearbook text without requiring 《》; the sentence had been swept past since round 29.
targetReport.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; the listing carries a 2023-02-15 and a 2025-06-04 edition.
